claim: The full fielding methodology of the Billion Dollar Boy burnout survey - Censuswide as fielding agency, July 2025 fieldwork, 500 US / 500 UK creator split, and 2,000+2,000 consumer arms - is disclosed only in this archived CosmeticsDesign-Europe article; the BDB press release itself omits this detail.
stance_target: methodology transparency / provenance of the anchor burnout survey
scope_conditions: Provenance/methodology-audit finding. This Wayback-archived trade article (captured 4 March 2026; live URL now dead after CosmeticsDesign's March 2026 closure) is the sole surviving record naming the fielding agency and exact sample split for the primary anchor study in this batch.
quoted_support: "The research, which was undertaken in July 2025 by Censuswide and commissioned by Billion Dollar Boy, quizzed 1,000 senior marketing professionals; 1,000 content creators in the US and UK (500 per market); 2,000 US consumers; and 2,000 UK consumers."

claim: 52% of the 1,000 US/UK content creators surveyed have experienced career burnout and 37% considered quitting the industry because of it, per the Censuswide/Billion Dollar Boy July 2025 survey.
stance_target: prevalence of self-reported creator burnout and quit intention
scope_conditions: DERIVATIVE restatement of the same n=1,000 US/UK Censuswide dataset as the BDB press release - not independent corroboration. Intention to quit measured among active creators; cannot capture anyone who already left. US/UK only.
quoted_support: "Global social media marketing agency Billion Dollar Boy has shared its new research, which reveals that 52% of creators quizzed have experienced career burnout and 37% considered quitting the industry because of it."
